user.title: Set up xg.glass Smart Glasses
user.description: Give this glasses device a name. You can add multiple devices (one config entry each).

data_description.device_name: A human-readable label shown in the Home Assistant UI, e.g. "Rokid Glasses".

display.name: Send to glasses display
display.description: Push text directly to the glasses display. The glasses companion app must be running and connected.

message.name: Message
message.description: The text to show on the glasses display.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional title prepended to the message.
